title: Ciudad Inteligente — Trazabilidad de avisos y cadenas
description: A que organismos se aviso de cada alerta, que eventos se correlacionan entre si, y por donde paso el vehiculo implicado.

list.name: incidente
list.label: Incidente
list.definition:
SELECT to_char(e.ts_utc, 'DD/MM HH24:MI:SS') || '  ' ||
       coalesce(e.zone, 'sin zona') AS __text,
       e.event_id::text AS __value
FROM events e
WHERE e.event_type = 'panic.button'
  AND e.ts_utc > now() - interval '24 hours'
ORDER BY e.ts_utc DESC
LIMIT 100

panels.title: Avisos emitidos

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS avisos FROM notifications n WHERE $__timeFilter(n.creado_en) AND (n.zone LIKE '$zona' OR n.zone IS NULL)

panels.description: Un aviso es una fila por organismo: una misma alerta de incendio produce dos, uno a bomberos y otro a ambulancia.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT count(DISTINCT n.organismo) AS organismos
FROM notifications n WHERE $__timeFilter(n.creado_en) AND (n.zone LIKE '$zona' OR n.zone IS NULL)

panels.title: Avisos fallidos

targets.rawSql:
SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE n.estado = 'fallido') AS fallidos
FROM notifications n WHERE $__timeFilter(n.creado_en) AND (n.zone LIKE '$zona' OR n.zone IS NULL)

panels.description: Un aviso fallido queda registrado igual que uno entregado: la diferencia entre 'no se pudo avisar' y 'no se intento' es justo lo que necesita saber una investigacion posterior.

panels.title: Alertas sin ningun aviso

targets.rawSql:
SELECT count(*) AS sin_aviso
FROM alerts a
WHERE $__timeFilter(a.created_at) AND a.zone LIKE '$zona'
  AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM notifications n WHERE n.alert_id = a.alert_id)

panels.description: El numero que de verdad importa. Una alerta sin aviso no produce ningun error: el sistema sigue funcionando y sencillamente nadie acude. Deberia ser cero; si no lo es, falta una fila en la matriz de despacho o el notificador estuvo caido.

panels.title: Avisos a terceros

targets.rawSql:
SELECT n.creado_en   AS "Hora",
       n.alert_type  AS "Tipo de alerta",
       n.zone        AS "Zona",
       n.organismo   AS "Organismo",
       n.canal       AS "Canal",
       n.estado      AS "Estado",
       coalesce(n.detalle, '') AS "Detalle"
FROM notifications n
WHERE $__timeFilter(n.creado_en) AND (n.zone LIKE '$zona' OR n.zone IS NULL)
ORDER BY n.creado_en DESC
LIMIT 300

panels.description: Canal 'simulado' significa que el aviso quedo registrado pero NO se entrego a ningun organismo real: no existe integracion con bomberos, policia ni ambulancias.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT n.organismo AS "Organismo", count(*) AS "Avisos"
FROM notifications n WHERE $__timeFilter(n.creado_en) AND (n.zone LIKE '$zona' OR n.zone IS NULL)
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

SELECT n.alert_type AS "Tipo", count(*) AS "Avisos"
FROM notifications n WHERE $__timeFilter(n.creado_en) AND (n.zone LIKE '$zona' OR n.zone IS NULL)
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Que evento se correlaciona con cual

targets.rawSql:
WITH recientes AS (
  SELECT a.alert_id, a.type, a.zone, a.score, a.evidence, a.created_at
  FROM alerts a
  WHERE $__timeFilter(a.created_at) AND a.zone LIKE '$zona'
  ORDER BY a.created_at DESC
  LIMIT 12
)
SELECT r.alert_id::text AS id,
       r.type           AS title,
       r.zone           AS "subTitle",
       round(r.score, 2)::text AS "mainStat",
       'ALERTA'         AS "secondaryStat"
FROM recientes r
UNION
SELECT DISTINCT e.event_id::text,
       e.event_type,
       e.zone,
       coalesce(e.payload->>'infraccion',
                e.payload->>'tipo_evento',
                e.payload->>'tipo_sonido_detectado',
                e.payload->>'velocidad_estimada',
                '') ,
       'evidencia'
FROM recientes r
CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements_text(r.evidence) AS ev(id)
JOIN events e ON e.event_id = ev.id::uuid

WITH recientes AS (
  SELECT a.alert_id, a.type, a.zone, a.score, a.evidence, a.created_at
  FROM alerts a
  WHERE $__timeFilter(a.created_at) AND a.zone LIKE '$zona'
  ORDER BY a.created_at DESC
  LIMIT 12
)
SELECT r.alert_id::text || ':' || ev.id AS id,
       r.alert_id::text AS source,
       ev.id            AS target
FROM recientes r
CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements_text(r.evidence) AS ev(id)

panels.description: Cada alerta con los eventos que la sustentan. La relacion sale de alerts.evidence, no de correlation_id: el enriquecedor asigna un correlation_id distinto a cada evento, de modo que ese campo no agrupa nada.

panels.title: Evidencias, evento por evento

targets.rawSql:
WITH recientes AS (
  SELECT a.alert_id, a.type, a.zone, a.score, a.evidence, a.created_at
  FROM alerts a
  WHERE $__timeFilter(a.created_at) AND a.zone LIKE '$zona'
  ORDER BY a.created_at DESC
  LIMIT 12
)
SELECT r.created_at  AS "Alerta",
       r.type        AS "Tipo de alerta",
       e.ts_utc      AS "Hora del evento",
       e.event_type  AS "Sensor",
       e.zone        AS "Zona",
       coalesce(e.payload->>'infraccion', '') AS "Infraccion",
       coalesce(e.payload->>'velocidad_estimada',
                e.payload->>'velocidad_detectada', '') AS "Velocidad",
       left(coalesce(e.payload->>'placa_vehicular', ''), 14) AS "Vehiculo"
FROM recientes r
CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements_text(r.evidence) AS ev(id)
JOIN events e ON e.event_id = ev.id::uuid
ORDER BY r.created_at DESC, e.ts_utc

panels.description: La misma informacion que el grafo, en forma de lista. Se mantiene a proposito: si el grafo no renderiza, esta tabla sigue respondiendo la pregunta.

panels.title: Incidentes: botones de panico

targets.rawSql:
SELECT e.ts_utc AS "Hora",
       e.zone   AS "Zona",
       coalesce(e.payload->>'tipo_de_alerta', '') AS "Aviso",
       coalesce((SELECT string_agg(DISTINCT a.type, ', ')
                 FROM alerts a
                 WHERE jsonb_exists(a.evidence, e.event_id::text)),
                'sin correlacionar') AS "Derivo en",
       e.event_id::text AS "Incidente"
FROM events e
WHERE e.event_type = 'panic.button'
  AND $__timeFilter(e.ts_utc)
  AND e.zone LIKE '$zona'
ORDER BY e.ts_utc DESC
LIMIT 200

links.title: Ver la trazabilidad de este incidente en el mapa

panels.description: Solo botones de panico: cada fila es el arranque de un incidente. Al pulsar una fila el mapa de al lado dibuja su trazabilidad completa. La columna 'Derivo en' dice que alertas se correlacionaron a partir de ese boton; 'sin correlacionar' significa que el pulsador no encontro eventos que lo acompanaran, que es el caso de falso positivo del enunciado.

panels.title: Trazabilidad del incidente, de principio a fin

targets.rawSql:
WITH cadena AS (
  SELECT '$incidente'::uuid AS eid
  UNION
  SELECT ev.id::uuid
  FROM alerts a
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements_text(a.evidence) AS ev(id)
  WHERE jsonb_exists(a.evidence, '$incidente')
),
arranque AS (
  SELECT min(e.ts_utc) AS t0
  FROM events e JOIN cadena c ON e.event_id = c.eid
),
vehiculos AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT e.payload->>'placa_vehicular' AS placa
  FROM events e JOIN cadena c ON e.event_id = c.eid
  WHERE e.payload ? 'placa_vehicular'
),
bruto AS (
  SELECT e.event_id,
         e.payload->>'placa_vehicular' AS placa,
         lag(e.ts_utc) OVER (PARTITION BY e.payload->>'placa_vehicular'
                             ORDER BY e.ts_utc) AS anterior,
         e.ts_utc
  FROM events e
  WHERE e.payload->>'placa_vehicular' IN (SELECT placa FROM vehiculos)
    AND e.ts_utc >= (SELECT t0 FROM arranque)
),
rastro AS (
  SELECT event_id,
         sum(CASE WHEN anterior IS NULL
                    OR ts_utc - anterior <= interval '30 minutes'
                  THEN 0 ELSE 1 END)
           OVER (PARTITION BY placa ORDER BY ts_utc) AS tramo
  FROM bruto
),
incidente AS (
  SELECT c.eid AS event_id, true AS es_evidencia FROM cadena c
  UNION
  SELECT r.event_id, false
  FROM rastro r
  WHERE r.tramo = 0
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM cadena c WHERE c.eid = r.event_id)
)
SELECT e.geo_lat AS latitude,
       e.geo_lon AS longitude,
       row_number() OVER (ORDER BY e.ts_utc) AS "Orden",
       CASE
         WHEN row_number() OVER (ORDER BY e.ts_utc) = 1
           THEN 'INICIO'
         WHEN row_number() OVER (ORDER BY e.ts_utc DESC) = 1
           THEN 'ULTIMO CONTACTO'
         ELSE ''
       END          AS "Hito",
       e.ts_utc     AS "Hora",
       e.zone       AS "Zona",
       e.event_type AS "Sensor",
       CASE WHEN i.es_evidencia THEN 'evidencia'
            ELSE 'seguimiento' END AS "Origen",
       coalesce(e.payload->>'infraccion', '') AS "Infraccion",
       coalesce(e.payload->>'velocidad_estimada',
                e.payload->>'velocidad_detectada', '') AS "Velocidad",
       left(coalesce(e.payload->>'placa_vehicular', ''), 14) AS "Vehiculo"
FROM incidente i
JOIN events e ON e.event_id = i.event_id
WHERE e.geo_lat IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY e.ts_utc

WITH alerta AS (
  SELECT a.alert_id
  FROM alerts a
  WHERE jsonb_exists(a.evidence, '$incidente')
  ORDER BY jsonb_array_length(a.evidence) DESC, a.created_at DESC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT (p->>1)::float8 AS latitude,
       (p->>0)::float8 AS longitude,
       ord            AS "Vertice"
FROM alert_routes r
JOIN alerta x ON x.alert_id = r.alert_id
CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(r.geometria)
  WITH ORDINALITY AS t(p, ord)
WHERE r.estado = 'calculada'
ORDER BY ord

panels.description: El punto verde rotulado INICIO es donde empezo el incidente; el rojo rotulado ULTIMO CONTACTO es la ultima vez que un sensor vio el vehiculo. La linea azul es el recorrido por calles que el motor de rutas considera mas probable entre esos puntos, y la flecha marca el sentido. OJO al explicarlo: el sistema NO midio ese camino, midio los puntos. La columna Origen distingue 'evidencia' (lo que sostiene la alerta) de 'seguimiento' (apariciones posteriores del mismo vehiculo). El rastro se corta cuando pasan mas de 30 minutos sin verlo; el sistema NO puede saber si eso fue porque se detuvo, porque salio de la ciudad o porque dejo de haber camaras. Pulse una fila de la tabla de la izquierda para ver otro incidente.
